name: Fund My Deductible
headline: A compliance-sensitive funding platform that doubled deals closed for contractors
overview: Fund My Deductible lets roofing and restoration contractors fund their customers' insurance deductibles through a legally complex workflow that had no dedicated software. Techlio built the secure three-sided platform end to end, connecting contractors, sales teams and homeowners with automated agreements, income tracking and full audit trails.

metrics.label: more deals closed, reported by contractors

challenges.title: No compliance infrastructure
challenges.text: Deductible funding is regulated differently state to state, and contractors had no software to execute agreements consistently.

challenges.title: Manual deal tracking
challenges.text: Arrangements lived in spreadsheets and paper agreements, creating risk of lost deals and disputes.

challenges.title: No sales team visibility
challenges.text: Salespeople could not track their own funded deals, commissions or agreement status.

challenges.title: High deal loss
challenges.text: Customers dropped out when the funding setup had too much friction.

solutions.title: Funding agreement engine
solutions.text: A legally structured digital agreement system that generates an executed funding agreement for every customer.

solutions.title: Three-portal architecture
solutions.text: Separate contractor, salesperson and homeowner portals, each with its own responsibilities and full transparency.

solutions.title: Automated income and performance tracking
solutions.text: A real-time dashboard of funded deals, payment status and team performance.

solutions.title: Five-minute homeowner onboarding
solutions.text: A signup flow where homeowners set up a payment plan and sign the agreement from any device.

results: 2x more deals closed, as reported by contractors after adoption
5-minute homeowner setup, reducing deal loss at the agreement stage
Three-portal system live for contractors, sales teams and homeowners
Platform endorsed by industry legal counsel at the Win the Storm conference
architecture: Three React portals share one Node.js API on MySQL, hosted on AWS. Stripe handles payments and payouts.
